page_title: STR 2-2 MNT | Strasbourg v Montpellier 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+7' The Montpellier players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+6' The goal for Montpellier is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.

90+4' Arnaud Nordin produces a sweet pass and picks out Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:3!
90+4' Referee Pierre Gaillouste halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Patrick Vieira, then shows him a yellow.
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Teji Savanier.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Lucas Perrin sends a terrific cross into the box. Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the right post.
88' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Pierre Gaillouste and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) is replacing Jordan Ferri.
82' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) prepares to take a corner kick.

82' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Patrick Vieira is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Thomas Delaine suffers an injury and Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) comes on.
81' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
79' 7:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
70' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Akor Adams is replaced by Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier).
70' Substitution. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) in, Wahbi Khazri out.
69' 2 - 2 Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 2:2.
66' Pierre Gaillouste sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
65' Wait! Referee Pierre Gaillouste has indicated he is going to review the Strasbourg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
63' 1 - 2 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Benjamin Lecomte (Montpellier) puts the ball into his own net.
61' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Kevin Gameiro will be replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
60' Substitution. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) on for Moise Sahi Dion.

59' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
58' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
57' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
54' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
53' Montpellier force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.

52' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.

51' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Benjamin Lecomte guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
51' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
47' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call.
46' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
46' Half-time substitution. Frederic Guilbert will not participate anymore and Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Patrick Vieira gives a chance to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) and Habib Diarra is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Pierre Gaillouste has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.

45+3' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Benjamin Lecomte, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
45+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Montpellier win a corner.
44' Referee Pierre Gaillouste sees the trip by Angelo (Strasbourg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
43' The shots on goal statistics – 0:3.

40' 0 - 2 Stunning strike! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) latches on to a precise through ball from Teji Savanier before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:2.
38' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.

34' Akor Adams (Montpellier) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
32' Poor challenge! Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle.
29' The referee is firm and issues Akor Adams (Montpellier) a deserved yellow card.
27' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
25' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
22' Pierre Gaillouste couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.
20' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.

17' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
15' A corner kick by Montpellier is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Strasbourg).
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
12' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier have a free kick.
11' It must be a yellow card. It is. Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
10' Montpellier will take a corner kick.
9' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Strasbourg will have an opportunity.
7' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.
3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier). Pierre Gaillouste saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Montpellier will take the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste will referee today's match.
